description: This file is a shell script containing functions and commands related to CVS and Git operations, including setup, checkout, comparison, and version detection.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying the CVS root configuration.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS module or branch.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a branch in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a file in CVS and Git branches.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares entire CVS and Git branches, including files and directory structures.
